profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
An experienced software developer who focuses on best practices such as test driven development, agile development, consistent application of design patterns, and paired programming.  Has experience with a full range of technologies, from client to server. Delivers high quality and tested software on time.  Team player.

Specialties: Technologies:  Grails, Java, Sproutcore, Titanium Appcelerator

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Core contributor to the Javascript frameworks used to play media on Apple Music and TV+ web
applications. Primarily responsible for audio/video playback of content.

* Built custom Typescript media players. Integrate with browser MSE API for media playback of fMP4
assets. EME API for DRM controls.
* Build light-weight custom MP4 parser to handle stream idiosyncrasies, as needed.
* Contribute to Music/TV+ Typescript frameworks.
* Develop Stencil.js web components for video playback as seen on Apple Music and TV+ web apps.
* Develop internal web applications with Svelte.js

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Full Stack engineer on Apple Education services focusing on refactoring, testing, maintainability, and
best practices.

* Develop RESTFul Spring Boot application for Podcast Connect Backend
* Develop RESTFul Spring Boot application for delivering podcast URLs to clients (1B+
requests a day)
* Mentor junior developers on Spring best practices (Inversion of Control, Dependency Injection)
* Developed Schoolwork web application (EmberJs), with focus on complicated API layer integrating
with both Java-backed services and CloudKit backed services.
* Continue UI development for iTunesU Course Manager application
* Develop Spring Boot application for driving live notifications to Course
Manager.
